'''Ulthven Keith''' is a miniboss in [[The Shadow Reef]]. He spawns on the first stage. He appears to wear the [[Privateer Pack|Privateer Pack outfit]] with the Privateer cutlass equipped, as well as an off-hand variant of a [[Brutal Claw]].
